review_basis: Exact spritesheet-standard.png cells shown in ordered native 192x208 montages, full contact sheet and idle face detail. Sequence inspection is ordered still review, not real-time video playback.

observations.idle: Clear eye closure in frames 2-3 and reopening in 4-5; small breathing variation. Arms remain relaxed, stable baseline.
observations.running-right: All faces and noses screen-right; leg swing and alternating near/far arm occlusion in 0-3 and 4-7. Stable scale and intact full bodies.
observations.running-left: All faces screen-left; visible passing/raised-leg and contact poses, alternating near/far arm occlusion. Independently generated.
observations.waving: Hand raises from resting to chest then open palm beside head and lowers. Connected wrists and hands, no detached wave effects.
observations.jumping: Starts crouched, rises, apex has both feet clearly airborne, descends and lands crouched on same ground baseline. Head size remains comparable to idle; compression comes from bent legs.
observations.failed: Head bows, hand reaches forehead, then chin and returns toward resting; coherent embarrassed/disappointed reaction.
observations.waiting: Hands clasp then rise toward chest and open palms outward asking for input, returns clasped. Distinct from review.
observations.running: Feet stay planted; folded arm and finger at chin with head/gaze changes convey thinking. No literal foot running.
observations.review: Hand at hip, downward inspection and blink/head tilt, distinct silhouette from thinking. Motion subtle but visible.

warnings: Gait is a gentle short walking cadence rather than athletic running; appropriate directional drag semantics. Several contact poses are visually similar.
Review motion is restrained; changes are primarily face/head rather than large body gestures.
Native sprite has tall mature proportions with narrow face, so tiny facial detail is less readable than larger head mascot proportions; supplied identity preserved.
cross_state: Same lilac-haired adult woman, ivory sweater, brown skirt/belt, tights/boots throughout. No new props or detached effects; no visible clipping. Idle-to-crouch-to-air-to-land-to-idle remains understandable with stable ground contact. Generated pose-perspective changes are small, no material scale pop visible in ordered montage.
